lag_note: ED volume (EDV) and left-without-being-seen (OP_22) are reported on a calendar-year window, not lagged like HVBP.
Median ED time-based measures (OP_18a-d) and OP_23 use a rolling ~12-month window ending closest to the FY2026 reporting cycle.

CMS HVBP performance periods are domain-specific and published per fiscal year in the Baseline Measures Report; exact dates are not reproduced here to avoid stating unverified figures. Lag is approximate.

HCAHPS survey period for the Person and Community Engagement domain; commonly ~2 years prior to the fiscal year.
